column2: A wide panoramic banner scene. The reaper stands left of centre, holding a small bouquet of lavender flowers and the scythe, in a calm little graveyard on a gentle lilac-tinted hill. Seven blank rounded tombstones of varied sizes spread evenly across the whole width, each with a large clean empty face (they will later carry app logos). Two crows perched on stones, a crescent moon top right, a few small clouds, grass tufts and sprouts. The whole scene sits in a wide horizontal strip; leave the top-left quarter as open white sky.

A wide short banner scene. On the left, three simple icon objects in a row with small arrows between them: a browser window with code brackets, a document with a pencil, an envelope with a small merge-branch symbol. On the right, the reaper leans in from the edge happily handing over the envelope. Lilac-tinted ground with grass tufts. Everything fits in a short wide horizontal strip across the middle, plain white above and below.

A wide short banner scene. The reaper waves goodbye with one hand, standing beside a single large rounded blank tombstone surrounded by lavender flowers and sprouts, small sparkles, on a lilac-tinted ground line. Everything fits in a short wide horizontal strip across the middle, plain white above and below.
The reaper sits at a laptop chatting with a friendly round robot with headphones and an antenna; small speech bubbles with dots between them.
The reaper sticks lavender sticky notes with checkmarks onto a big board, a notebook and pen nearby.
The reaper moves a card between three columns of a kanban board on a stand; a small calendar with a checkmark nearby.
The reaper waves into a video-call window showing a friendly ghost; several speech bubbles float around.
The reaper paints at an easel with a palette, a vector pen-tool shape and a camera nearby.
The reaper types at a big terminal window with code brackets and a branch graph, a coffee mug on the desk.
The reaper tends a tall server rack with blinking dots, a cloud and a small container box beside it.
The reaper watches a monitor showing a heartbeat pulse line, a small alarm bell and a scroll of log lines.
The reaper inspects a big bar chart on a board through a magnifying glass, a small pie chart nearby.
The reaper calls through a megaphone while a few envelopes fly out like birds.
The reaper sorts a stack of contact cards into a funnel, a rolodex beside it.
The reaper wears a headset and smiles at a help speech bubble with a question mark shape, a ticket stub beside it.
The reaper pushes a small shopping cart holding coins and a receipt, a credit card leaning on it.
The reaper holds up a big key ring in front of a shield badge, a small ID badge clipped to the robe.
The reaper carries a stack of folders toward an open filing cabinet, a cardboard box beside it.
The reaper arranges content blocks inside a large browser window like building blocks.
The reaper relaxes holding a phone with app tiles on the screen, headphones, a coffee mug and a small plant.
